why_it_halted.the_gate: The founder's governing promotion set is 54 census / 17 CLEAN_PET_FRIENDLY / 10 CLEAN_VERIFIED_NO_PETS / 13 corridors. The order fails closed if it computes anything else.
why_it_halted.the_row: Days Inn Perrysburg, 10667B Fremont Pike, Perrysburg 43551
why_it_halted.who_was_wrong: the agent. PTF-TOLEDO-OH-NEW-MARKET-001's wrong-evidence audit tested merge conflicts against a read's DISPLAY NAME instead of against the census identity it resolves to. The founder's 10 was a faithful restatement of that defective number.

the_defect_in_full.what_the_merge_found: The census row at 10667 Fremont Pike is claimed by two different Wyndham chain identities: 'Days Inn by Wyndham Perrysburg/Toledo' and 'Super 8 Perrysburg Toledo'. The merge reported the conflict and refused to choose, which is correct.
the_defect_in_full.what_the_audit_did: It held the read captured as 'Super 8 Perrysburg Toledo', whose display name matched a claimant string, and published the read captured as 'Days Inn Perrysburg', whose display name matched neither claimant string even though it resolves to the same census identity. One building, two reads, opposite treatment.

quotes: ADA defined service animals are welcome at this hotel.

the_defect_in_full.why_this_matters_more_than_one_row: The two pages state OPPOSITE policies at one address stem, and one of them prints a building letter the other does not. That is the signature of a dual-brand campus -- a Days Inn in the B building and a Super 8 in the A building -- which address_key cannot separate because it strips the letter. Publishing the refusal under the merged identity would have put a 'no other pets' fact and a 'Dog-friendly' fact on one row.
the_defect_in_full.the_fix_applied: The audit now resolves a merge conflict to the CENSUS IDENTITY and its aliases, not to a display name. Both reads on the unresolved building are held, which is what founder ruling TOLEDO-R2 requires.

what_the_founder_is_being_asked.question: The governing set says 10 verified no-pets; correctly applying TOLEDO-R2 gives 9. Which governs?

option_a.label: Proceed at 9
option_a.means: TOLEDO-R2 applied as written. 10667 Fremont Pike stays held as an unresolved Group A identity, both of its reads withheld. Toledo promotes at 54 / 17 / 9 / 13.
option_a.agent_recommendation: RECOMMENDED. R2 is unambiguous and the 10 came from the agent's own defective count. Withholding a refusal is the conservative direction: the hotel is simply not listed either way.

option_b.label: Rule on 10667 Fremont Pike now
option_b.means: Split it into two identities -- Days Inn at 10667B (VERIFIED_NO_PETS) and Super 8 at 10667 (its 'Dog-friendly' read is an amenity chip and would stay held) -- or name one as the successor. A split would give 10 verified no-pets, reached by a ruling rather than by publishing an unresolved row.
option_b.agent_recommendation: This is a real ruling the evidence supports, but TOLEDO-R2 forbids the agent from inventing it. It needs the founder.

what_the_founder_is_being_asked.what_the_agent_will_not_do: Publish the Days Inn refusal under the merged identity to reach 10. That is the exact defect no technical gate catches, and TOLEDO-R2 names it.
